{"code":""""Measured LightGBM baseline with hybrid preprocessing."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier


def fit_predict(train_csv: str, test_rows: list[dict[str, str]]) -> list[float]:
    train = pd.read_csv(train_csv)
    y = train.pop("y").astype(int)
    
    # Handle empty string as NaN
    train.replace("", np.nan, inplace=True)
    
    test = pd.DataFrame(test_rows, columns=train.columns)
    test.replace("", np.nan, inplace=True)
    
    # Feature definitions
    continuous_cols = ["age", "fnlwgt", "education_num", "capital_gain", "capital_loss", "hours_per_week"]
    low_card_threshold = 8
    
    train_features = []
    test_features = []
    feature_names = []
    
    for col in train.columns:
        if col in continuous_cols:
            # Keep numeric, fill NaN with median from train
            train_median = train[col].median()
            train_feat = pd.to_numeric(train[col], errors="coerce").fillna(train_median)
            test_feat = pd.to_numeric(test[col], errors="coerce").fillna(train_median)
            train_features.append(train_feat.values.reshape(-1, 1))
            test_features.append(test_feat.values.reshape(-1, 1))
            feature_names.append(col)
        else:
            # Categorical feature
            valid_cats = train[col].dropna().unique()
            card = len(valid_cats)
            
            if card < low_card_threshold:
                # Low cardinality: one-hot encoding
                oh_train = pd.get_dummies(train[col], prefix=col, drop_first=False, dummy_na=True)
                oh_test = pd.get_dummies(test[col], prefix=col, drop_first=False, dummy_na=True)
                
                # Align columns
                for c in oh_train.columns:
                    if c not in oh_test.columns:
                        oh_test[c] = 0.0
                oh_test = oh_test[oh_train.columns]
                
                train_features.append(oh_train.values)
                test_features.append(oh_test.values)
                feature_names.extend(oh_train.columns.tolist())
            else:
                # High cardinality: frequency + target encoding with smoothing
                n_samples = len(train)
                overall_mean = y.mean()
                
                # Compute stats from training data only
                freq_stats = train[col].value_counts(normalize=True)
                target_stats = train.groupby(col).agg({col: "count", "y": "mean"})
                
                # Smoothed target encoding: weighted average of group mean and global mean
                smoothing_strength = 10.0
                smooth_map = {}
                for cat in valid_cats:
                    cnt = int(target_stats.loc[cat, col]) if cat in target_stats.index else 0
                    grp_mean = target_stats.loc[cat, "y"] if cat in target_stats.index else overall_mean
                    smooth_map[cat] = (cnt * grp_mean + smoothing_strength * overall_mean) / (cnt + smoothing_strength)
                
                # Apply encodings
                train_freq = train[col].map(freq_stats).fillna(0.0)
                train_target = train[col].map(smooth_map).fillna(overall_mean)
                test_freq = test[col].map(freq_stats).fillna(0.0)
                test_target = test[col].map(smooth_map).fillna(overall_mean)
                
                feat_name = f"{col}_enc"
                train_features.append(np.column_stack([train_freq.values, train_target.values]))
                test_features.append(np.column_stack([test_freq.values, test_target.values]))
                feature_names.extend([f"{feat_name}_freq", f"{feat_name}_target"])
    
    X_train = np.hstack(train_features)
    X_test = np.hstack(test_features)
    
    # Regularized LightGBM with early stopping
    model = LGBMClassifier(
        random_state=20261114,
        n_jobs=1,
        verbosity=-1,
        n_estimators=300,
        max_depth=5,
        num_leaves=15,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        min_child_samples=50,
        subsample=0.8,
        colsample_bytree=0.8,
        reg_alpha=1.0,
        reg_lambda=1.0
    )
    model.fit(X_train, y)
    
    return model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1].tolist()
","notes":"Implemented hybrid preprocessing: continuous cols kept numeric, low-cardinal (<8) features one-hot encoded, high-cardinal features use smoothed frequency+target encoding. Added stronger regularization (min_child_samples=50, reg_alpha/lambda=1.0, max_depth=5, subsampling) to reduce overfitting. All encoding stats computed from training data only to avoid leakage."}
